excerpt.en: Share your concept, target market, vessel style and scent direction.
excerpt.zh: 请提供品牌构想、目标市场、容器风格与香型方向。

body.en:
![Fragrance collection](/assets/current-template/hero.jpg)

## Start with your brief
Tell us about the product category, visual mood, fragrance family and packaging idea. We will discuss what can be developed before confirming specifications or production.

## A clear project path
Brief → concept discussion → sample requirements → specifications → quotation. Availability, minimum order quantity and lead time are confirmed for each project.
body.zh:
![香氛系列](/assets/current-template/hero.jpg)

## 从需求简报开始
请说明产品类别、视觉风格、香型方向和包装想法。我们会先讨论可行方案，再确认规格与生产事项。

## 清晰的合作步骤
需求简报 → 概念沟通 → 样品需求 → 规格确认 → 报价。起订量和交期以具体项目核实为准。

title.zh: 认真对待每个制作环节

excerpt.en: An introduction to the production steps we can discuss with your team.
excerpt.zh: 了解可与采购团队逐项沟通的制作环节。

body.en:
![Concept image of fragrance workspace](/assets/current-template/factory.jpg)

## From components to finished presentation
Container selection, filling, assembly, labeling and packing each have a place in the project brief. Actual processes and capacity should be confirmed against the selected product and facility.

## Visit and verify
Ask us for current factory photographs, a production walkthrough and documentation relevant to your order before making a sourcing decision.
body.zh:
![香氛工作空间概念图](/assets/current-template/factory.jpg)

## 从部件到成品呈现
容器选择、灌装、组装、贴标和包装都应写入项目需求。实际工艺与产能须结合具体产品和工厂核实。

## 参观与核验
在作出采购决定前，请索取当前工厂实拍、生产流程资料及与订单相关的文件。

title.en: Quality begins with a clear brief

excerpt.en: Define samples, materials and acceptance criteria before order confirmation.
excerpt.zh: 在订单确认前明确样品、材料与验收标准。

body.en:
![Concept image of fragrance evaluation](/assets/current-template/quality.jpg)

## Agree on what matters
Discuss appearance, vessel compatibility, scent direction, labeling and packaging requirements in your sample brief.

## Confirm the evidence
Product specifications, test reports and any certifications should be requested and verified for the exact item and destination market. No unverified claim is implied here.
body.zh:
![香氛评估概念图](/assets/current-template/quality.jpg)

## 先明确验收重点
在样品需求中沟通外观、容器适配、香型方向、标签及包装要求。

## 核对相关文件
产品规格、测试报告及认证须针对具体产品和目标市场索取并核验；本页不作未经证实的资质承诺。

title.zh: 让自然香气有自己的表达

excerpt.en: CedarOrigin is a concept brand presentation for a home-fragrance manufacturing website.
excerpt.zh: CedarOrigin 是香薰工厂官网的品牌视觉方案。

body.en:
![Botanical home fragrance](/assets/current-template/hero.jpg)

## A considered fragrance direction
This website presents design possibilities for reed diffusers, scented candles and room sprays. Product and company facts will be updated after the brand owner supplies verified materials.

## Work together
Share your product brief through the inquiry form and we can start a focused conversation.
body.zh:
![植物系家居香氛](/assets/current-template/hero.jpg)

## 用心规划香氛方向
本网站呈现藤条香薰、香薰蜡烛和室内喷雾的设计方向。待品牌方提供核实资料后，再更新实际产品与企业信息。

## 开始沟通
您可以通过询盘表单提交产品需求。
